name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Trump confirms strikes on Iranian air defences; Iran calls US reply on Hormuz plan unconvincing
state: Trump confirmed US strikes on an Iranian anti-aircraft site, reported on Qeshm Island, calling it a 'minor attack' (Al Jazeera, 4 Nov). Iran's security council secretary called the US reply to its Hormuz plan 'not convincing'; Qatar says both sides remain committed to talks. The IRGC claimed on 4 Nov that four tankers hit mines and that it shot down US drones (bne IntelliNews).
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states. Disruption to flights and shipping in the region can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states; Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran says US reply to Hormuz plan unconvincing; Trump confirms strikes
bne IntelliNews — IRGC says four more tankers hit mines, US drone downed

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
